title: How to Prepare Your Store's Product Photos for Black Friday (Start Now, Not November)
description: Black Friday traffic converts on visuals. Here's the pre-Q4 photo workflow smart sellers finish months in advance.

blocks.text: Every year in early November, sellers panic. They realize their product photos aren't ready for the biggest sales weekend of the year. They rush. They cut corners. They lose sales.
Here's the pre-Q4 photo prep smart sellers finish in August.
Why Photos Matter More During Black Friday
Black Friday traffic is:

items.text: More competitive (every seller is running ads)
More visual (buyers scroll faster, decide quicker)

blocks.text: Your normal photos might convert at 2%. Your Black Friday-optimized photos should target 4-5%.
The Pre-BF Photo Audit
Right now, this week, do this:

items.text: Compare against competitors ranking above you in Google/Amazon
Note the gaps: consistency, background quality, lifestyle context

blocks.text: You just built your prep list.
The Refresh Workflow
For each top-10 product:
Step 1: Upload existing photo to edit-photo.com, remove background, get a clean master file.
Step 2: Create 5 variations from the master:
Step 3: Save all versions in a Q4-only folder.
Step 4: Schedule the swaps for the week before BF.
Black Friday Visual Elements
Sellers who convert during BF include:

items.text: Discount badges directly on product images

blocks.text: All require clean transparent PNGs as base assets. edit-photo.com provides those after local processing.
The Ad Creative Angle
Your Black Friday ad creatives will need:
All easily built from transparent PNGs. If you enter November without transparent PNG masters of your top products, you'll spend Black Friday panicking instead of profiting.
Timeline

items.text: August: Photo audit + master file creation
September: Build variations, brief ad creators
October: Test ads at low spend
Black Friday: Watch your dashboard, sip coffee

blocks.text: Sellers who do this out-earn scramble-and-hope sellers by 3-5x during BF.
Start Prepping Now
The best time to prepare Black Friday photos was three months ago. The second-best time is today. Start free at edit-photo.com.
